records.text: Nissy said the rear camera was normally used as a wide-angle camera, but the ground was not visible in the footage Farnsworth selectively shared with Owens.

appearances.snippet: The camera is a wide angle camera and was always used as such. However... In the footage that Terrell (Terrell Farnsworth) has selectively shared with Candace (Candace Owens), you cannot see the ground.

verification.notes: Verified as a quoted-attribution claim. The Nissy segment says the rear camera was consistently used as a wide angle in earlier tour examples and says the footage Farnsworth shared with Owens did not show the ground. The source confirms Nissy made the comparison; it does not independently authenticate or measure every underlying video file.

records.text: Nissy said either the UVU camera setup had been changed and zoomed in that day, or Farnsworth had zoomed or cropped the footage after the fact.
records.speaker: Nissy (YouTuber; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: So either that day at UVU, they had changed things up and they had zoomed in the camera so that you couldn't see the area around Charlie (Charlie Kirk), or Terrell (Terrell Farnsworth) had zoomed in after the fact, and he was showing a cropped version of the footage to Candace (Candace Owens).

verification.notes: Verified that Nissy presented the two alternatives stated: a changed/zoomed setup at UVU or a later zoom/crop by Farnsworth. The transcript clearly frames them as alternatives and inference rather than a proven conclusion, matching the opinion categorization.
